key_insight: AbsorbEvo uses an agentic loop to turn natural-language absorber targets into simulated designs by combining LLM-guided parameter edits, a physics prior, and feedback from prior runs.
engineering_relevance: The framework could speed up microwave absorber design by reducing expert trial-and-error while keeping final candidates grounded in full-wave electromagnetic validation.
method: LLM proposes parameter update direction and magnitude from task goals and search history
Generate candidates via directed increments plus global sampling, then rank them with a low-cost predictive physics model
Run full-wave simulation only on top candidates; validate physical plausibility and distill reusable textual skills from prior tasks
evidence_signal: On AbsorbBench-36 under equal proposal budgets, AbsorbEvo reached 79.17% task success and 0.7816 mean best coverage, outperforming a generic agent and random search.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the predictive surrogate, validity checks, and simulation budget, so transfer to new absorber families may require careful recalibration.
paper_title: AbsorbEvo: An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Inverse Design of Microwave Absorbers
